lineage.strategy: Acquire current quarterly operating evidence to replace older growth snapshots and distinguish contracted demand from realized profitability.

observations.fact: Planet reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $116.1 million, up 58% year over year, and adjusted EBITDA profit of $13.9 million.

Planet ended the quarter with approximately $865 million of cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments; reported remaining performance obligations were about $753 million and backlog about $815 million.
The issuer IR news index confirms current FY2027 reporting cadence and recent government/operational awards, including national and government satellite-data programs during summer 2026.

risks.risk: Backlog and performance obligations are not equivalent to recognized revenue, and adjusted EBITDA excludes items relevant to GAAP profitability; conversion quality and capital intensity remain important underwriting questions.

unknowns.unknown: The primary IR index available in this acquisition pass did not expose the full Q2 release body, so exact quarterly values are independently sourced and should be primary-filed/issuer-release corroborated by Alpha before numeric scoring.

recommendation: Use this as a current operating lead with explicit provenance limitation; Alpha should corroborate the Q2 values against the issuer release or SEC filing before authoritative numeric underwriting.
